nodes.label: Historical NestJS dual-database research
nodes.rationale: The research records an earlier scaffold state and driver choices; it must not be interpreted as current repository status.

nodes.label: Native pg and MongoDB driver approach
nodes.rationale: Official drivers meet connection requirements without requiring ORM mappings; later business logic must write SQL and MongoDB queries.

nodes.label: Environment configuration validation
nodes.rationale: Use @nestjs/config, reject missing connection settings and provide credential placeholders rather than default or copied passwords.

nodes.label: Mocked e2e and read-only database checks
nodes.rationale: Replace database providers in routine e2e tests and separately validate PostgreSQL SELECT 1 and MongoDB ping without creating tables or changing data.

nodes.label: knowledge_hub database initialization schema
nodes.rationale: Initialization scripts describe kh_document and document_content, but their existence does not prove those scripts ran against live databases.
